title: Garlic-Lemon Aioli
description: A quick mayo-based aioli with grated garlic, lemon and Dijon, made in one bowl.

ingredients.name: fresh garlic
ingredients.note: small, finely grated, or 1/4 tsp garlic powder

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.note: optional, a tiny pinch to round the acidity

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add {mayo}, {garlic}, {lemon}, {dijon}, {salt} and optional {sugar} to a small bowl.

steps.title: Stir
steps.text: Stir until smooth and fully combined.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: Taste and adjust: more lemon for brighter, more salt if needed.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Refrigerate for 10 to 20 minutes until serving so it thickens slightly.

notes: Serves two generously. Pairs with Chicken Smash Patties.
